last.verdict: Casinos beat plan and raised guidance; online loss shrank to $18.3 million, with a Q4 profit forecast.

takeaways.label: Casinos lead
takeaways.text: Casino revenue hit $1.5 billion with profit margin up for a third straight quarter to 33.7%. Full-year casino profit guidance rose $10 million to $1.973 billion.

takeaways.label: Online nears breakeven
takeaways.text: Online adjusted loss narrowed to $18.3 million from $76.6 million. Management guides to a $18.7 million profit in Q4, leaving a full-year loss of about $20 million.

takeaways.label: Alberta launch promising
takeaways.text: Alberta's online sports betting share is already near Ontario's levels. Online casino there is about halfway to Ontario, in a market larger than management expected.

takeaways.label: Debt keeps falling
takeaways.text: Net debt fell to $1.76 billion from $2.22 billion at the end of 2025. Net leverage dropped to 2.3x EBITDA from 4.5x, with no big maturities until 2029 after $400 million due January.

history.verdict: Record casino results and a smaller digital loss won modest approval.

reasons.label: Record casino quarter
reasons.text: Retail revenue hit a record $1.5 billion; nine properties set Q2 records, and July trends stayed strong.

reasons.label: Digital losses shrinking
reasons.text: Interactive lost $9.5 million versus $62.0 million a year ago; iCasino revenue hit a record.

reasons.label: Profit jump, debt falling
reasons.text: Adjusted EBITDA rose to $312.6 million from $236.1 million; net debt fell to $1.9 billion.
